retry_and_failure_rules: Never overwrite an existing valid capture; a valid capture is immutable once sealed.
Preserve failed/partial attempts under a separate, provenance-labelled sibling path (e.g. '<workload-id>-failed-<reason>'), never inside the canonical output directory.
A pre-launch failure (e.g. stale ARGINE_LLAMA_DIR, model/runtime not found) does not count as a scientific capture and is excluded from sealing.
A capture is canonical only after: trace file existence is confirmed, normalize() succeeds, and reconcile() returns [].
A malformed or incomplete trace is rejected, its provenance is preserved for the record, and it is never reused or silently discarded.

A retry must use the identical frozen acquisition parameters (model, runtime, seed, threads, threads_batch, ctx, expert budget, workload path) -- no parameter may be changed in response to a prior failure or in response to any observed model output.
No prompt or configuration change is permitted in response to model output at any point in this protocol.
No parallel capture writers: captures are executed strictly sequentially, one workload at a time, exactly as Phase 2A's handoff (and this one) requires.
A timeout during capture is not a PASS and must not be recorded as a successful cell.
